transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been having a really hard time coping with stress lately. For the past four months, I've felt extremely overwhelmed, anxious, and down, and it has just become too difficult to handle on my own. That's why I finally decided to seek help today.
Did these symptoms begin after a specific stressful event or life change?
Yes, they started right after I was laid off from my job. That happened about four months ago, and these feelings began within just a few weeks of losing my position.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yes, I've been feeling incredibly down and hopeless almost every day. I've also lost all interest in the things I used to enjoy, like my hobbies and spending time with friends. It's just really hard to find any pleasure in anything right now.
Have these symptoms been present most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
Yes, they definitely have been present almost every single day. In fact, it has been going on for much longer than just two weeks—it has been constant like this for about four months now.
Have you had changes in sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration along with these symptoms?

To be honest, I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep or appetite. I'm not really sure about my energy or concentration levels either, as I've just been so overwhelmed by the stress of losing my job.
How much have these symptoms interfered with your daily functioning, like work, relationships, or taking care of yourself?

I'm not quite sure how to measure how much it's interfered, but things have just felt really difficult lately. It is hard to pin down exactly how, but getting through each day has just been a general struggle.
Have you had any feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt, or any thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
I definitely feel a deep sense of hopelessness and my mood is constantly very low. However, I don't have feelings of excessive guilt, and I haven't had any thoughts of ending my life.
Did the symptoms feel out of proportion to the stressor or continue even after you started adjusting to the job loss?
I'm not really sure if my reaction was out of proportion, because losing my job was such a major shock to me. It has just been incredibly hard to adjust, and everything still feels very overwhelming.
Besides feeling depressed and losing interest, have you had several other symptoms like sleep changes, appetite changes, low energy, poor concentration, or slowed movements most days?

No, I haven't really noticed or experienced those specific symptoms like sleep or appetite changes. I'm not sure about things like slowed movements either, as my main struggle is just the constant stress and low mood.
Have your symptoms been severe enough to cause clear problems in your work, relationships, or ability to take care of yourself?
I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about it in terms of specific problems in those areas, as I've just been focused on trying to get through each day.

final_diagnosis.reason: Symptoms began within weeks of a clear psychosocial stressor (job loss) and have persisted for about 4 months with prominent depressed mood, anxiety, hopelessness, and loss of interest. The presentation lacks enough additional depressive symptoms (sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, guilt, suicidality) to clearly meet Major Depressive Disorder criteria, making Adjustment Disorder the best fit.
